verdict.rationale: Agent-analysis features (sentiment analysis, success evaluation, structured data extraction, semantic conversation search) generate AI-derived insights from the user's own conversation data, which partially satisfies the story. However, these are evaluation/reporting metrics rather than proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations for next actions, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of this analytics experience. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive suggestion generation (e.g., recommended actions/optimizations), a dashboard summarization view, and independent verification beyond first-party docs.
